verdict_vs_market.quote: A senior PM offer at about $458K is below where it should be.

verdict_vs_current.quote: This offer is a pay cut for a move to the same level

recommendation.quote: Don't accept this as it stands, and don't walk away yet. Negotiate.

equity_grounding.quote: At the full ask, you'd get $255K base, about $51K bonus and $300K/yr in equity, so about $606K/yr. That's a ~15% raise over Meta

uses_public_incumbent_benchmark.quote: One Levels.fyi page puts Google's Senior PM figure for San Francisco at $530,000.

refresh_valued_at.quote: Judge the offer on the guaranteed part.

level_claim.quote: Meta IC6 is roughly equal to Google L6

walkaway_tied_to.quote: Decline if Google won't move the guaranteed pay to at least what you make at Meta now

unsupported_claims.claim: Equity and sign-on bonuses have more room to move than base salary
unsupported_claims.quote: Equity and sign-on bonuses usually have more room to move than base

ask_focus.quote: Equity and sign-on bonuses usually have more room to move than base, so push hardest on those.

year1_vs_recurring.quote: Front-loading only moves money into the early years. The total is still $800K, so years 3–4 get much thinner

forfeiture_as_loss.quote: If you leave before your annual bonus pays out, you lose that ~$36K. That's a real cost of switching, and a sign-on bonus should cover it.
